svg.title: The same fairness audit, run twice, under two ways of reading the judge
svg.desc: Each dot is one person-and-request pair: how much stated identity moved the judge's probability of refusing in the first run (across) against the second run (up). Left, with the judge's written confidence, the dots form a shapeless cloud: correlation 0.05, so the shifts were noise. Right, with the probability read from the judge's token logprobs, the dots lie on the diagonal: correlation 0.97, so the shifts are real and repeatable.
